text:
The evidence confirms **67.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2020**, but it does not establish whether that loss was deforestation or a regulatory violation. Tree-cover loss alone does not necessarily mean forest was permanently converted to another use.

The loss occurred before the 31 December 2020 baseline. For 2021–2025, no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected, although 0.4 ha of loss in smaller patches was recorded in 2021. The JRC 2020 map classified none of the property as forest, but this does not resolve the status of the 2020 loss.
